Remark
[Forward difference quotient]

Of course, if the distance function is differentiable at $t=t_0$ then the derivative statement is equivalent to the forward difference quotient statement. Thus, in the proof of this result we shall always work with the forward difference quotients.

Proof

↗ def:geodesic \sketch Apply Claim 6 to the estimate in Claim 6.

□

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Geodesic length suffices for distance]
